description: This file defines an Android activity called EditorActivity, which handles creating and editing notes within a notes application. It manages UI interactions, menu actions, and communicates with a NotesRepository to persist note data.

classes.name: EditorActivity
classes.description: An Android activity facilitating note creation and editing, connected to the UI and data repository.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads note data if editing an existing note.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu with a save action.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles toolbar menu actions, including save and navigation.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Validates input and saves the note through the repository, either creating or updating a note.
